title: Lucas & Sarah
description: Sarah has doubts about Lucas... Is he really honest?

questions.question: He told me he wasn't on any dating app anymore. Can you check for me if he's still active on a dating app? If so, which one?
He uses Tinder on another device? Which one?
questions.hint: Check his emails, there's a login email to Tinder from a new device.

questions.question: Does he have a premium subscription to a dating app... If so, how many dating apps is he signed up for?
questions.hint: Check the emails and his banking apps.

questions.question: What? He told me he only used Tinder, what's the other dating app he has a subscription to?
Try to find his Tinder bio please…
answer: I can delete Tinder for you
questions.hint: Look for a screenshot of his Tinder profile.

questions.question: So he's still talking to other girls… If so, which ones?
How many in total?
questions.hint: Count the number of active conversations.

questions.question: Ok… Anissa, Amélie and Sandrine. Where did he meet Anissa and Amélie?
And Sandrine, where did they meet?
questions.hint: Read the messages between Lucas and Sandrine carefully.

questions.question: He gives me a cute nickname "babe"… Am I the only one who gets it? Who else does he call that?
questions.hint: Compare the nicknames used in different conversations.

questions.question: Is there something else off about his replies to these girls? Like is he lying about something? If so, what?
questions.hint: Look for inconsistencies in what he tells the girls.

questions.question: He told me he was an entrepreneur… What's his real job?
questions.hint: Check his income on the banking apps.

questions.question: So he's unemployed... What a liar! Was I at least his first Tinder date? If not, with who?
He told me he was in Dubai on July 18 and couldn't see me. What country was he really in?
questions.hint: On that date, check his photos. You can unblur the photo with an app on his phone. It will give you a location.

questions.question: On our first date, he gave me a necklace supposedly worth €400. I'm sure he lied. What's its real price?
In which city in Belgium?
questions.hint: Check Google Maps, compare with the photo you found, the exact location.

questions.question: Do you know what time the date was please?
A date with an "L", he lies to so many girls… I want to warn this girl. Find her first and last name.
questions.hint: On ChatGPT he describes perfectly the woman he's going to meet, you need to find this woman in the phone.

textSuccess: Wow... Thanks for digging through all of that. So he's talking to multiple girls, lying about his job, and his "trip to Dubai" was actually a date in Bruges with some girl named Léa. I have all the proof I needed. I'm going to warn as many girls as possible.

onboardingContent.text: Hi… A friend told me about you. Apparently, you're really good at finding the truth. I need your help, it's important.
My name is Sarah. I met Lucas on Tinder a few weeks ago. Our first date was perfect. He was attentive, funny, and he told me he wasn't talking to anyone else.
But since then, I've had this gut feeling I can't shake. Late replies, vague answers about his evenings… Everything might be too perfect, you know?
I managed to get access to his phone. I'm not the type to snoop, but I need to know. Is he really honest… or is he playing the field?

notes.title: Pasta recipe
notes.content:
CARBONARA PASTA (easy version)

- 200g pasta
- 150g bacon bits
- 2 egg yolks
- Sour cream (one spoon)
- Shredded cheese
- Salt, pepper

1. Cook pasta
2. Fry bacon bits
3. Mix eggs + cream + cheese
4. Pour on hot pasta OFF THE HEAT
5. Add bacon

Done in 15 min 👌

messages.content: what are the best agents on Valorant to climb in ranked?

Here are the best agents to climb in ranked:

🔫 DUELISTS (to carry)
- Jett: incredible mobility, dash + knives
- Reyna: self-heal, perfect for duels
- Raze: huge area damage

🛡️ INITIATORS (very useful)
- Sova: essential recon
- Fade: very meta right now
- KAY/O: suppresses enemy abilities

🧱 CONTROLLERS (if you like to lead)
- Omen: smokes + TP
- Viper: insane zone control
- Astra: very strong in teams

🏰 SENTINELS (to anchor)
- Killjoy: perfect site defense
- Cypher: constant info
- Chamber: still strong despite nerfs

💡 MY ADVICE
- Bronze/Silver: Reyna or Phoenix to learn duels
- Gold/Plat: Sova or Fade to help the team
- Diamond+: any agent you've mastered

The key is to main 2-3 agents max and really know them!

messages.content: I have a date at a bar called Bar Chantant with a girl who is short, brunette, long hair, brown eyes, she has a small nose piercing, a birthmark on her forehead and she's a nurse, how should I handle it?

Great, a first date at Bar Chantant! Here are my tips:

🎯 BEFORE THE DATE
- Arrive 5-10 min early to find a good table
- Choose a casual but polished outfit
- Make sure your phone is charged

💬 CONVERSATION TOPICS
- Her nursing career: ask why she chose that path
- Open-ended questions: "What do you enjoy about your job?"
- Her passions, hobbies, travels
- Avoid negative topics

✨ ATTITUDE TIPS
- Regular eye contact
- Active listening: follow up on what she says
- Be yourself, no need to play a role

⚠️ THINGS TO AVOID
- Talking too much about yourself
- Looking at your phone
- Talking about your exes

Good luck! 🍀

how to make a good homemade kebab?

Killer homemade kebab recipe:

🥙 INGREDIENTS (serves 4)
- 500g ground meat (beef or mixed)
- 1 grated onion
- 2 cloves of garlic
- Spices: cumin, paprika, coriander, pepper
- Pita bread or flatbread
- Lettuce, tomatoes, onions

🍖 THE MEAT
1. Mix meat + onion + garlic + spices
2. Marinate at least 1h in the fridge
3. Shape into elongated patties
4. Cook in a hot pan or oven (400°F, 15-20 min)
5. Slice into strips

🥗 WHITE SAUCE
- 100g Greek yogurt
- 1 tbsp mayonnaise
- 1 pressed garlic clove
- Herbs: dill or mint
- Salt, pepper

🔥 HOT SAUCE
- Mayonnaise + harissa + a bit of ketchup

📦 ASSEMBLY
1. Warm the bread
2. Spread white sauce
3. Add the meat
4. Top with: lettuce, tomatoes, onions
5. Hot sauce on top
6. Roll it up tight

That's a wrap bro 👌
how to build muscle fast?

To build muscle effectively:

💪 TRAINING
- 3-4 sessions/week minimum
- Compound exercises: squat, bench press, deadlift
- Progressive overload: gradually increase the weight
- 8-12 reps for hypertrophy

🍗 NUTRITION (THE MOST IMPORTANT)
- Caloric surplus: eat more than you burn
- Protein: 1.6-2g per kg of body weight
- Sources: chicken, eggs, tuna, whey, legumes
- Don't skip carbs!

😴 RECOVERY
- 7-8h of sleep MINIMUM
- Muscles are built during rest
- 48h between each muscle group

⏱️ REALISTIC TIMELINE
- Beginner: 0.5-1kg of muscle/month possible
- After 1 year: it slows down
- No miracle shortcuts

⚠️ COMMON MISTAKES
- Not eating enough
- Too much cardio
- Changing programs all the time
- Skipping leg day

Consistency > magic programs
